title: Phase 1 fix: onset glitches in DelayLamaVoice
intro: The glitches from the phase 4a listening test, before and after the helper fix (DelayLamaVoice keeps a released note's tail from getting louder). Clips marked 'steady' or 'on time' also use a diagnostic copy of the phase 4a script with one thing changed, to tell helper bugs from script and profile causes. Monk alone, dry, as written; one gain per test.

tests.title: Bass: the 'laser gun' start
tests.question: Bass line as written (c01). Which clips still start notes like a laser gun?
tests.notes: Before: the phase 4a render. After: the helper fix (a note's tail no longer jumps back to full level when the script raises the gain for the next note, 15 ms early). Steady vowel: after, plus a diagnostic script copy that holds the vowel at 0.12, removing the profile's fast 'a' to 'u' sweep at each start. Fixed generator: the script regenerated by phase 4a's generator after its two timing fixes, with the old and the fixed helper.

tests.title: Guitar: too high between two hits
tests.question: Guitar line as written (c07). Which clips still go too high (or mix two pitches) between notes?
tests.notes: Before and after are the same apart from the last note's tail. Bend on time: a diagnostic script copy where each slide's starting bend arrives with its note-on. In the original it arrives 5 ms later, so every slid note first sounds 5 ms at its target pitch, then drops about 3 semitones and slides back up.

tests.title: Trumpet: the slight super high pitch
tests.question: Trumpet line as written (c03). Which clips still have the slight super high pitch?
tests.notes: Before and after are the same apart from the last note's tail. Two suspects: the profile's breath burst at the start of every note, and a whistle near 3 kHz on the A4, B4 and D5 notes, where the third formant meets a harmonic (it starts about 60 ms into those notes and holds). Steady breath removes the burst only.
